title: 店舗用折り畳み式オーニング
description: たわみのある縞キャンバス、波形垂れ幕、左右の関節アームと壁付けカセットを備えた展開状態のオーニング。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: An extended static awning with gently sagging striped canvas, scalloped valance, articulated support arms and a wall cassette. No animation or load rating. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
